BeforeSideTurnEnd.maps_to: on_player_turn_end (paels_tears.py:27-28), dispatched by HookSystem.on_player_turn_end (hooks.py:297-301) from CombatState.end_turn (combat.py:654)
BeforeSideTurnEnd.rationale: PaelsTears.cs:38-46 records `HadLeftoverEnergy = base.Owner.PlayerCombatState.Energy > 0` behind a participation check; paels_tears.py:28 is `self.had_leftover_energy = player.energy > 0`. Slot is right: hooks.py:297-307 documents on_player_turn_end as Hook.BeforeTurnEnd, and BeforeSideTurnEnd is Hook.BeforeTurnEnd's THIRD sub-slot (Hook.cs:1254-1260) -- the last of the three, so anything that spends or grants energy in BeforeSideTurnEndVeryEarly/Early is already counted on both sides. The participation check is structurally satisfied: the sim only fires this from the player's own end_turn. Strictly greater than zero on both sides, so an exactly-empty energy pool records False.

AfterSideTurnStart.maps_to: on_player_turn_started (paels_tears.py:30-33), i.e. the POST-draw turn-start slot
AfterSideTurnStart.rationale: PaelsTears.cs:48-55 grants `PlayerCmd.GainEnergy(base.DynamicVars.Energy.BaseValue, base.Owner)` when the flag is set; CanonicalVars is `new EnergyVar(2)` (line 34) and no AscensionHelper.GetValueIfAscension appears in the file, so ENERGY = 2 (paels_tears.py:21) is the pinned non-ascension value. Slot verified by execution, not off the relics/base.py docstring (PROMPT.md bug class 11): `py audit/tools/relic_probes.py turn-order` puts on_player_turn_started after modify_hand_draw and the draw, which is where audit/records/seam/turn_structure.json places AfterPlayerTurnStart / the player-side AfterSideTurnStart (step 23). Note the relic deliberately does NOT clear the flag after granting -- so a second consecutive turn ended with energy left grants again, and a turn ended empty clears it at BeforeSideTurnEnd -- and the sim matches that exactly.

AfterCombatEnd.issue: Closed 2026-07-27: the per-combat reset exists. `Relic.reset_for_combat` is declared on the base (sts2_rl/relics/base.py:177-190) and `Relic.attach` runs it every time the relic joins a new CombatState (sts2_rl/relics/base.py:192-195) -- one sim boundary standing in for the three C# spells it (AfterCombatEnd / BeforeCombatStart / AfterRoomEntered(CombatRoom)), and it also covers the hole AfterCombatEnd alone leaves when a fight ends inside play_card. sts2_rl/relics/paels_tears.py:27-30 clears `had_leftover_energy` (PaelsTears.cs:57-61, the relic's only reset). WAS: nothing in the sim ever put the flag back, so the relic worked in the first combat of a run only.

guards.what: G2 (LIVE, mechanism owned by relic/paels_eye G3): on a Pael's Eye extra turn the sim skips on_player_turn_end entirely, so the flag is never refreshed before the extra turn reads it
guards.rationale: The mechanism this entry rolls up (paels_eye G3) is closed: sts2_rl/combat.py:793 fires `on_player_turn_end` before the extra-turn test at :823, exactly as CombatManager.cs:1179's Hook.BeforeTurnEnd precedes :1366's Hook.ShouldTakeExtraTurn. Consequently relics/paels_tears.py:32-33 latches `had_leftover_energy` from the just-ended turn's unspent energy (PaelsTears.cs:38-46), and the extra turn's `on_player_turn_started` at relics/paels_tears.py:35-38 reads a freshly-set flag rather than the previous turn's stale one — so the +2 Energy on a Pael's-Eye extra turn now matches PaelsTears.cs:48-54.  RECONCILED 2026-07-28 (Task 0, ledger-vs-code pass after the Tier 1 fix campaign): this entry was recorded `gap` against pre-campaign code and the divergence is closed today. The issue it replaced read: MECHANISM: the sim's CombatState.end_turn consults should_take_extra_turn FIRST and returns (combat.py:648-652), so on_player_turn_end (combat.py:654) never runs on that turn; C# runs the whole turn-end pass and only then asks (CombatManager.cs:1179 vs :1366). The consequence for THIS relic is that the extra turn's on_player_turn_started reads a stale had_leftover_energy: C# would have just set it from the (necessarily unspent, since no card was played) energy pool and granted +2, whereas the sim grants +2 only if the PREVIOUS turn happened to leave the flag set. REACHABILITY (LIVE, executed -- `py audit/tools/relic_probes_b11.py eye-turnend` shows the on_player_turn_end slot firing without Pael's Eye and not firing with it, on the same end_turn call). Both relics are Ancient and co-obtainable: the ported Pael shrine offers one option from each of three pools per visit (Pael.cs:154-172; events/pael.py) and repeats across acts, with Tears in pool 1 and Eye in pool 3. Per binding rule 3 this is ONE mechanism with ONE verdict: it is recorded in full at audit/records/relic/paels_eye.json guard G3, which owns the extra-turn machinery, and reproduced here because the observable (2 energy) is this relic's.

Structurally satisfied: the sim fires on_player_turn_end only from the player's own end_turn (combat.py:654) and on_player_turn_started only from PlayerCombatState.start_turn (player.py:184), so the owner is always a participant. Multiplayer-only in effect, noted per the shared contract rather than verdicted as a divergence.

Both ADD to the current pool rather than raising the per-turn maximum, so the +2 is spendable this turn only and does not compound with the next turn's reset. Checked deliberately because the sibling relic paels_flesh in this batch takes the other route (ModifyMaxEnergy) and confusing the two would make Pael's Tears permanent.
